text.tspan: OpenGerminal: Pipeline Architecture and Component Replacements
based on Germinal commit 1e1c1a5 · OpenMM · FreeSASA · sc-rs
Structure prediction · pLDDT / iPTM / PAE loss
Antibody language model · sequence naturalness loss
JHU non-commercial license (code MIT; commercial use restricted)
AbLang integration by Germinal team (PR #55, #64, #68, commit 1e1c1a5). OpenGerminal sets ablang as pipeline default (previously iglm in vhh.yaml configs).
PCGrad: AF-Multimer + AbLang gradients merged at each design step → update CDR logits [L × 20]
CDR residue redesign (framework & interface residues fixed)
sc-RMSD · iPTM · pLDDT · pAE · filter thresholds
Commercial license required — UW Tech Transfer Office
dG, SAP, hbonds via ref2015 force field
MIT / Apache 2.0 / LGPL — no commercial license required
OpenMM energy minimization · FASPR sidechain repack
† binder_score, interface_dG, and interface_hbonds use fixed pass-through values following the FreeBindCraft strategy (Ring, 2025, Apache 2.0); these filters rarely reject designs in practice.
PyRosetta replacement (OpenMM, FreeSASA, sc-rs, Biopython) is the primary contribution of OpenGerminal, adapted from FreeBindCraft (Ring, 2025).
sc-rs adapted from FreeBindCraft (Ring, 2025, Apache 2.0). OpenMM relaxation protocol from pr_alternative_utils.py (FreeBindCraft, Apache 2.0).
AbLang integration implemented by Germinal team (Mille-Fragoso et al., 2025, PR #55/#64/#68). OpenGerminal contribution: setting ablang as default in all VHH run configs.
